headline: 216 Appleton Street Phase 2 awarded $500k in historic tax credits; payment approved for South High Street feasibility study.
summary: Virgilio Property gave a six-month update on 123 Pine Street. Talks covered a Newton Street neighborhood action plan and a proposal to move $300K from the 216 Appleton Street project to help Newton Street homeowners, with a preference that the money go to the roof and smokestack. Minutes from June, July, and August 2026 were also approved.
decisions: Approved payment for the South High Street reuse analysis and redevelopment feasibility study, with 3 yes votes and 1 abstention.
Approved the minutes from June, July, and August 2026, 3-0.
City Council approved the transfer of 31, 43, and 61 Newton Street to HRA.
216 Appleton Street Phase 2 was awarded an additional $500k in historic tax credits.
